title: pilosella pseudeffusa
intro: Pilosella pseudeffusa, commonly known as False Oxeye Daisy, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella pseudeffusa include acting as an antioxidant and a potential treatment for various ailments such as digestive issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
